text: Computer Science and Technology is a comprehensive discipline that studies the design, principles, applications and related technologies of computers. Its core lies in exploring the laws of representing, processing, storing and transmitting information, while also focusing on how to solve practical problems through the combination of software and hardware. This major combines theoretical depth and practical breadth, serving as the foundation for the development of modern information technology and being the core force driving innovations in fields such as artificial intelligence, big data and the Internet.
